name: Sacrarium Gelus
source:
Winter in the Andatal region has always been harsh, but the people always come together.

Not this year. Not for you. 

Sacrarium Gelus is a short fantasy-romance VN that follows its protagonist (name and pronouns customizable) during one of the lowest points of their life. Unexpectedly, a curse mark has appeared on them, and, for the safety of their village, they have been driven out into the winter snow. 

The only way forward that isn't wholly lethal is to traverse the dangerous, devil-infested Mt. Gelus. They survive the long trip around. The only way forward is through it. This journey puts them under the cold gaze of the sole, formerly human denizen of this mountain: Heimos, the living god of medicine and winter. No one knows about this man beyond the legends...until they meet him themself.

Will these interactions start off on the right foot? Will they learn more about Heimos during their stay or maintain their distance? Will they try to steal from a living god? That's up to you. 

Made for Winter VN  Jam 2022.

[From [url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/sacrarium-gelus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安达塔尔地区的冬天一直很严酷，但人们总是聚集在一起。

今年不行。不适合你。

《Sacrarium Gelus》是一部奇幻浪漫短篇小说，讲述了主角（名字和代词可定制）经历人生最低谷的故事。不料，他们身上出现了诅咒印记，为了村庄的安全，他们被赶到了冬雪中。

唯一不完全致命的前进道路是穿越危险且恶魔出没的格鲁斯山。他们在长途旅行中幸存下来。前进的唯一出路就是通过它。这次旅程将他们置于这座山上唯一的前人类居民的冰冷注视之下：赫莫斯，活着的医学之神和冬季之神。除了传说之外，没有人知道这个人……直到他们亲眼见到他。

这些互动会顺利开始吗？他们会在逗留期间更多地了解Heimos还是保持距离？他们会试图从活神那里偷东西吗？这取决于你。

专为2022年冬季VN Jam打造。

[来自[url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/sacrarium-gelus]Itch.io[/url]]
